newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN TO PROPOSE CUT IN CORP TAX TO 35 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN TO PROPOSE CUT IN CORP TAX TO 35 PCT.

text.p: Czech Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik said on Wednesday he would propose a cut in corporate income tax to 35 percent from the current 39 percent with effect from January 1, 1998.
Kocarnik added that personal income tax thresholds would be raised in order to ensure that after inflation, the overall tax burden on individuals would be unchanged.
He also said that indirect tax increases on cigarettes and petrol would amount to around 6.8 billion crowns.
